name: @pipeworx/mcp-coordinates

tools.name: midpoint
tools.description: Geographic (great-circle) midpoint between two lat/lon points.

tools.name: centroid
tools.description: Average (spherical) center of a list of lat/lon points. `points` is an array of {lat, lon}.

tools.name: bounding_box
tools.description: Bounding box (SW/NE corners) around a center point at a given radius. `unit` = km (default) or mi.

tools.name: point_in_bbox
tools.description: Test whether a lat/lon point is inside a bounding box "minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-coordinates forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the coordinates pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
